description: Prepare a design in GridGarden Studio for the user and return a link that opens it in the editor, plus the price WITH VAT and the parts list. Use it when the user wants to see/try a raised bed layout or a garden plan: a Brick Premium raised bed (rectangle / L / U / wall, mm) and optionally a whole garden (plot shape and size, house, entrance, style, wants, plants). Give what the user told you; for anything they did not say either omit it or pass it in `assumed` — never invent silently. Unknown values are rejected with a clear message (no silent fallback). The link opens the editor directly (no welcome window), the user can edit and order there. Price and parts are computed by Studio itself; quote `price.total_incl_vat` (with VAT) and say the country. Nothing is paid or ordered here, and no AI image generation is started. The design is saved anonymously (no personal data); anyone with the link can open it, the first edit makes the user their own copy.

assumed.description: Fields the user did NOT say and you guessed (they are shown as "estimated" in Studio). Always list them honestly.

beds.description: How many identical beds (1–20). Needs shape. Price and parts are for all of them.

country.description: Delivery country, ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 (DE, AT, SK…). Prices differ by market; ask the user. Omit only if unknown (then SK base prices, said in the result).

entry.description: Where the gate/entrance is: left | middle | right (on the street side unless entrySide).

entrySide.description: Boundary of the entrance: street (default) | left | right | back.

entryX.description: Entrance position along the boundary, mm

from_agent.description: Which assistant you are (chatgpt, claude, perplexity, gemini, copilot, or mcp/agent). Used only for anonymous counting. Default mcp.

house.description: Where the house stands (street at the bottom): street | middle | back | corner | none.

houseCell.description: House position as a 3x3 grid cell 1–9, keypad layout 7 8 9 / 4 5 6 / 1 2 3 (street below 1 2 3).

houseX.description: House x, mm from the lower-left plot corner at the street (with houseY)

houseY.description: House y, mm from the street (with houseX)

layers.description: Brick layers (raised beds 2–13, walls 1–25; each ≈120 mm tall).

length2.description: lshape: whole second leg length incl. the corner, mm

link.description: Optional: a ready GridGarden Studio link (https://gridgarden.eu/studio/<lang>/design/new?v=1&…). Its query is used as the input; the other fields below override it. Normally leave this out and pass the fields.

locale.description: Language of the Studio page the user will open (sk cs de en fr hu it nl pl ro). Use the language the user speaks. Default en.

north.description: North direction in degrees 0–360 (accepted, not used yet)

plants.description: Plant keys from studio_plant_catalog. They are saved as the user's planting wishes in the design; the planting itself (where each plant stands) is done in Studio.

plot.description: Plot shape: rect | narrow | l | other (other = rectangle for now).

plotArea.description: Plot area in m2 if the user knows only that (9–40000); the plot becomes a rectangle estimate

plotCut.description: plot=l: which corner is missing (default ne = back right; the street is at the bottom).

plotCutD.description: plot=l: depth of the missing corner, mm

plotCutW.description: plot=l: width of the missing corner, mm

plotD.description: Plot depth away from the street, mm (3000–200000)

plotW.description: Plot width at the street, mm (3000–200000; 12 m = 12000)

shape.description: Raised bed / wall type: rectangle | lshape | ushape | wall. Needs its dimensions and layers (see studio_design_options).

style.description: Garden style: modern-minimal | cottage | scandinavian | naturalistic | family-productive | mediterranean-gravel | japanese | formal | open (let the design decide).

terrace.description: Existing terrace as a grid cell "1"–"9" (or "none").

wants.description: What the user wants: veg, seating, kids, pets, lowcare, nolawn.

name: studio_create_design

design.description: Normalized design (dimensions after snapping to the 60 mm grid).

design_url.description: Open this: the saved design in Studio (or the prefill link when saved=false).

prefill_url.description: The same design as a stateless prefill link (works without the saved scene).

title: Create a GridGarden Studio design for the user
